ModMetaData.name: Ancient Urban Ruins Hit Point
ModMetaData.author: Meteores
ModMetaData.description:
After a short break, I finally gave HP to the walls and some objects, and it turned out to be surprisingly simple.
This mod is partially incompatible with existing saves.
FAQ: Hey! Why do my walls have -1 HP?!?!? - If you live in ancient ruins - DO NOT INSTALL THIS MOD! - If you are currently looting ancient ruins - DO NOT INSTALL THIS MOD!! - If you started the 'Safe House' or 'Scavenger Group' scenario - DO NOT INSTALL THIS MOD!!!
